name: Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS) for Normalized Embeddings
description: For unit-normalized vectors (e.g. OpenAI text-embedding-3 or Cohere embeddings), cosine similarity is identical to the inner product (dot product), which executes even faster.
prompt:
For unit-normalized vectors (e.g. OpenAI text-embedding-3 or Cohere embeddings), cosine similarity is identical to the inner product (dot product), which executes even faster.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: product_id, product_name, dot_product_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- MIPS search for normalized user query vector [0.85, 0.52, 0.0]
            SELECT 
                product_id,
                product_name,
                ROUND(array_inner_product(norm_vector, [0.85, 0.52, 0.0]::FLOAT[3]), 4) AS dot_product_score
            FROM product_catalog_vectors
            ORDER BY dot_product_score DESC
            LIMIT 2;
why_it_fails: Re-normalizing vectors in every query wastes compute when embeddings are pre-normalized upon insertion.
